assertions.name: scenario A: clicking 加入会话 opens the collapsed conversation column even with an existing draft and attachment
scenario A: exactly one append-mode prefill request carrying the real collection prompt and attach hook
scenario A: composer is the existing draft plus a blank line plus the collection prompt (draft preserved, no separator when empty branch not taken)
scenario A: no blocking toast, no send, no send-like request
scenario B: non-plain composer returns draft-protected and shows the new append-specific toast copy
scenario B: protected result keeps the draft untouched, performs no append and stays on the library root
no browser request escaped the fixture origin; no console exceptions

boundaries: Host seams and the conversation column/composer are synthetic; this is not a full Host install. The stub realises the hub append contract; the real hub append logic is covered by hub unit tests (18 pass) and is not re-implemented by the browser harness.
Real: product InspirationSection bundle, production local handlers/store, real loopback HTTP, real DOM/composer writes and clicks in headless Chrome.
The synthetic attachment fact (attachments=1) proves the append path is not blocked by an existing attachment; it is not a rendered attachment tray.
No Dev app (port 45120), no user profile, no external network; dynamic loopback ports only; Chrome/server/temp store cleaned up.
